EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk1A

FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE MEMBER OF THESRI JAYAWARDHANAPURA KOTTE MUNICIPAL COUNCILUNDER SECTION 65A(2) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS the office of a member in Sri Jayawardhanapura Kotte Municipal Council has fallen vacant by reason ofresignation;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the recognized political party namely United People's Freedom Alliance towhich the former member, Don Ranjan Ponnamperuma belonged was required by me under Section 65A(2) of the aforesaidOrdinance, to nominate within a period of thirty (30) days, a person eligible under the ordinance for election as a memberof that Sri Jayawardhanapura Kotte Municipal Council who shall be declared elected as a member ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mr. Arachchige RajikaLalitha Kodithuwakku being an eligible person under the aforesaid Ordinance to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Sivasubramaniam Achchuthan, Returning Officer of Sri Jayawardhanapura Kotte MunicipalCouncil acting in terms of Section 65A(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of vacanciesin Local Authorities (Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr. Arachchige RajikaLalitha Kodithuwakku elected as a member of the Sri Jayawardhanapura Kotte Municipal Council.
S. ACHCHUTHAN,Returning Officer,Sri Jayawardhanapura Kotte Municipal Council.City Elections Office,Colombo,13th August, 2015.
